teaching_notes.reusable_rule: Keep the instruction as one stage when its turns, traversal and target selection form one coupled maneuver and no independent intermediate completion point is stated. Preserve all action order and conditions in the same stage.
teaching_notes.five_element_focus: Check entry, target, complete ordered process, supported ending, and scoped conditions in the actual English text. Audit fields cannot replace missing words.
teaching_notes.handoff_focus: A boundary is not a physical stop. Verify the previous exit and next entry refer to the same established region/object/frame.
teaching_notes.retrieval_rule: Retrieve for short or tightly coupled routes where splitting at a turn, pass-by cue or descriptive observation would create an orientation-only stage without an independent navigation target.
teaching_notes.anti_pattern: Do not split merely because the source contains multiple verbs or sentences; do not invent an intermediate stop or endpoint.
